subject: Review rework: all 12 items fixed; one decision needed on the fps floor; WebKit iPad-landscape scroll test failed once on CI (retry unknown)
body:
S12a rework for review 20261116T152910-lead-d682d9: all 12 items addressed.

Commits on claude/naadi-shared: 124ea21 (1), b9a6294 (2,3,4,5,7,8,10,11,12), 4b6ed2f (6,9, live canvas sized to content), 383a9e7 (phone toolbar overflow, robust marker visual test), 6d29105 (off-screen slabs wait for free memory; fps floor rule), 71490f0 (PROGRESS numbers).

1. Undo/redo restamp updatedAt=now; recordInkDiff (shared) keeps tombstones. Unit test: undo/redo win mergeInkItems against a replica that saw the intermediate tombstone.
2. Page-wide CanvasBudget (24 Mpx) counts ink, marker and live canvases, with LRU eviction across surfaces. Pinned = on screen or being drawn. Slab backing is released once settled into images and restored from the image on the next edit. Off-screen painting only takes free memory (tryAcquire). Unit tests (incl. 12 surfaces). e2e: 12 pages at dpr 2 peak 22.9 Mpx, 0 evictions. New project webkit-ipad-portrait-dpr2.
3. markerMode under|multiply, defaulting from surfaceType (pdf_page = multiply). Visual e2e over an opaque table row: the under-layer marker is hidden by the opaque fill; the multiply marker shows.
4. Lasso and Ask work on a region with no ink: {ids: [], bbox, rect, path}, png null. PNG documented as ink-only; the consumer composites the page content.
5. Gate: /api/me when signed in, auth config when signed out, public-config fallback. Third webServer (APP_ENV=prod). ink-gate.spec: public and student get Page not found, admin gets the lab. Green on CI Chromium with real auth. WebKit is skipped there because the prod CSP upgrade-insecure-requests breaks http loopback in WebKit. Stale VITE comment and skip removed.
6. Test renamed; ink >= 0.7 x ink-hidden; >= 25 fps when the ink-hidden run reaches 30 fps (decision needed, below). DEVICE_CHECKLIST line updated. WebKit investigation: contain and will-change gave no gain; the settled images themselves cost about 25% under WebKit software raster. Live canvas sized to content: WebKit dpr-2 p50 latency 107 to 43 ms.
7. Unselected swatch ring is border-text-3; e2e checks 3:1 contrast.
8. pendingLatencyTs only when null; PROGRESS numbers re-recorded.
9. Frozen-copy axe (seg03 fixtures): Firefox lasso + renders x10 locally, 20/20 green.
10. Erase runs in the rAF frame; live outline is cached 64-point chunks plus a bounded tail; the settle PNG encodes in a module worker (OffscreenCanvas). Main-thread cost 0.5 to 9 ms per page settle.
11. InkSurface enabled is required; the engine defaults to off.
12. Ink on is the single lime control (e2e). The toolbar is one horizontally scrollable row. Phone screenshots are full page.

Decision needed: the 25 fps floor only applies when the runner's ink-hidden baseline reaches 30 fps. WebKit desktop and dpr 2 runs scroll this page below 25 fps even with no ink, so an unconditional floor would always fail.

Tests: unit ink 48, web 73, shared 49 (all green). Local ink + ink-gate matrix (19 projects, 2 workers, load ~22): 311 passed, 2 failed (the unconditional 25 fps floor on WebKit desktop/dpr2, which is now conditional), 48 skipped. CI (run 43919834187, cancelled by later pushes): Chromium e2e job green incl. ink-gate with real auth. WebKit: one ink.spec:604 (scroll) failure on ipad-landscape, retry outcome unknown because the run was cancelled. Firefox: no ink failures before the cancel.
